name: ReNature Fund
summary: Capital grants of £2,000 to £25,000 for practical habitat creation and improvement in or linked to the South Downs National Park, open to community groups, charities, councils and land managers. Enquiry form first.
reporting: Grant conditions usually include providing habitat monitoring information for up to 10 years and allowing monitoring visits.

calls.label: April and October deadlines
calls.recurring: Deadlines are 1 April and 1 October each year; enquiry form first.

applicant_types.quote: Applications are welcome from local authorities, parish councils, charities, community interest companies, constituted voluntary groups, landowners and land managers.

geography.quote: Sites must be within the South Downs National Park, or create significant habitat links into or out of the National Park.

access.quote: Please read the funding guide above and complete an enquiry form in the first instance.

window.quote: Full applications can be submitted twice a year, in April and October.

amount.quote: Grants of £2,000 to £25,000 are available from the South Downs National Park Trust towards capital costs.

reporting.quote: providing habitat monitoring information for up to 10 years allowing access for SDNP staff monitoring visits (with advance notice given)
